text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 16: Calendar and slowly changing weather columns; the 51 members agree for about the first 3 days and then spread out'
text.tspan: Figure 16: Calendar and slowly changing weather columns; the 51 members
agree for about the first 3 days and then spread out

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'One ECMWF ensemble run from the validation year: the run whose PV farm mean actual power over its first 10 days is the median of the 53 runs. Rows, top to bottom: the eight calendar columns, then six weather columns, as the production XGBoost model is given them. Units: degrees Celsius, pascals, and metres (geopotential height). Each panel has its own y axis. The solar and wind generators share a weather grid cell, so one column serves both. The two time-of-year rows show the change from the first hour, because their values would date the run.'
text.tspan: One ECMWF ensemble run from the validation year: the run whose PV farm mean actual power over its first 10 days is
Rows, top to bottom: the eight calendar columns, then six weather columns, as the production XGBoost model is given
them. Units: degrees Celsius, pascals, and metres (geopotential height). Each panel has its own y axis.
The solar and wind generators share a weather grid cell, so one column serves both. The two time-of-year rows show
the change from the first hour, because their values would date the run.
